emma (devex): Heads-up: quickstart generator sample causing flaky CI when containers get SIGTERM. repro in sandbox: container doesn't exit because goroutines hang on stream read.

noah (go-sdk): ugh, we've seen similar. paste the snippet?

emma (devex): verbatim from quickstart:```go
ctx := context.Background()
it := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer it.Close()
for it.Next() { fmt.Print(it.Token()) }
```

rachel (infra): that's the one. Background() + long-lived stream = trouble. infra's container lifecycle relies on process exit; tests hang.

noah (go-sdk): two fronts to fix: API ergonomics so examples are safe, and runtime so reconnects/auth refresh don't block Next(). current pump goroutine waits on network read and doesn't observe Close()/cancel.

emma (devex): could we add a single-line helper that new devs copy-paste to get correct signal/timeouts? that's the easiest DX win.

noah (go-sdk): propose NewGeneratorAutoCancel(ctx, req) -> (it, finish). If ctx is non-cancellable (eg Background), helper creates internal cancellable ctx and returns finish() which calls it.Close(). For callers that already have cancellable ctx, it just returns a passthrough finish no-op. keeps samples tiny.

rachel (infra): nice. also recommend making Close() always close a done chan and be idempotent so any blocked Next() selects on done and unblocks.

noah (go-sdk): Agreed. Implementation plan: (A) wire Close() to cancel internal ctx + close(done) (B) Next() uses select over done, tokenCh, errCh so reconnects can push err and unblock Next() (C) expose sentinel errors: ErrAuthReconnect and ErrClosed so infra/docs can distinguish causes.

emma (devex): docs ask: include a tiny snippet showing signal.NotifyContext and WithTimeout. new devs copy quickstart line-by-line into prod. small example like:```go
ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt)
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
it, finish := client.NewGeneratorAutoCancel(ctx, req)
defer finish()
for it.Next() { fmt.Print(it.Token()) }
if err := it.Err(); err != nil { log.Printf("stream error: %v", err) }
```

noah (go-sdk): also discussing TryNext(ctx) as an advanced API: per-Next deadline for interactive UIs. keeping it opt-in. for quickstart we'll stick to helper + sample.

rachel (infra): for auth-reconnect behavior: please make reconnect surface an error on iterator rather than silently retrying forever. infra teams need deterministic shutdown. ErrAuthReconnect that wraps the underlying error is perfect.

noah (go-sdk): we'll add ErrAuthReconnect and ErrStreamClosed. Next() will return false and Err() will be the wrapped error. also adding unit tests: simulate auth refresh mid-stream and SIGTERM.

emma (devex): timeline for docs + sample update? i'll prep the onboarding blurb once PR lands.

noah (go-sdk): i'll open a draft PR today: code changes + updated quickstart + migration note in changelog. ETA 48 hours. will include a short migration note: "If you relied on blocking Next() behavior, switch to NewGeneratorAutoCancel or call Close() explicitly."

emma (devex): tiny UX request: in the quickstart, add a one-liner comment above the loop: "// use a cancellable context for long-running streams (signal handling shown)". helps people not skip it.

noah (go-sdk): will add that. also adding an example in advanced.md showing TryNext(ctx) for interactive shells.

rachel (infra): once CI passes ping infra so we can swap the template used by the container image.

noah (go-sdk): PR merged. changelog entry: "Go SDK: generator - safer cancellation semantics and NewGeneratorAutoCancel helper; iterator surfaces reconnect errors instead of blocking." tagging @devex for the onboarding copy.

emma (devex): thanks all! i'll update quickstart and add the gotcha note in onboarding. small change but should reduce a lot of flaky support tickets.
